metaDescription: CPT 99495 explained: Transitional Care Management with moderate complexity and a visit within 14 days of discharge. Deadlines, rules and 2026 rate.
summary: Covers the 30 days after a hospital or facility discharge when decision-making is at least moderate and the face-to-face visit happens within 14 days.
time: Contact within 2 business days; visit within 14 days
performer: Practitioner for the visit; clinical staff for outreach
frequency: Once per patient in the 30 days after discharge
requirements: Interactive contact with the patient or caregiver within 2 business days of discharge
A face-to-face visit within 14 calendar days
Moderate or higher complexity decision-making documented
Medication reconciliation on or before the visit date
Review of the discharge information and needed follow-up
pitfalls: Missing the 2-business-day contact, which makes the episode non-billable
Two practitioners billing TCM for the same discharge
conflicts: Only one TCM code is reported per patient per 30-day period.

faqs.question: What happens if the 2-business-day call is missed?
faqs.answer: Documented attempts matter, but a missed required contact generally makes the episode unbillable. Dedicated outreach staff and tracking reduce the risk.

faqs.question: Which discharges qualify for TCM?
faqs.answer: Discharges from an acute hospital, rehab, skilled nursing or similar facility to the community setting. Eligibility is confirmed per patient and payer.
